name: Loneliness
overview: Scripture reveals that loneliness is not part of God's original design, as He declared it was not good for man to be alone and provided a suitable helper for him (Genesis 2:18). In times of abandonment or personal isolation, believers are encouraged to be strong and courageous, trusting that the Lord will never fail or forsake them (Deuteronomy 31:6, 8; Joshua 1:5, 9). Those who seek God can find assurance in His faithful presence and protection, which overcomes the fear and distress often associated with loneliness (Psalms 9:10).
